options: A paid add-on that only runs inside the Salesforce browser UI
A SOQL function that loads data into a query
A free, official Salesforce desktop app for bulk data operations using CSV files
A tool that only exports data and cannot change records
questions.explain: Data Loader is Salesforce's free client app for bulk insert, update, upsert, delete and export, working with CSV files.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a Data Loader operation?
options: Compiling Apex triggers
Insert
Upsert
Export
questions.explain: Data Loader moves record data in and out; it does not compile Apex code.

questions.q: Why does the Production versus Sandbox choice at login matter so much?
options: It only changes the colour of the login screen
Sandbox logins are faster but otherwise identical
It controls the batch size automatically
It decides which org your changes go to, so a wrong pick can load or change data in the wrong place
questions.explain: Selecting the wrong environment is a real way to touch live data by accident.

questions.q: What does the Batch Size setting control?
options: How many CSV files can be open at once
How many records are sent to Salesforce in each batch, with a default of 200
The maximum number of fields in a SOQL query
How long the login session stays open
questions.explain: Batch Size sets the number of records processed per batch; the default is 200.

questions.q: What does the Insert Null Values setting decide?
options: Whether Data Loader inserts records that have no Id
Whether the export includes empty files
Whether blank cells in your CSV overwrite existing field values with nothing
Whether the sandbox refreshes after a load
questions.explain: With it on, empty CSV cells clear existing values; with it off, blanks are ignored on updates.
